scope: Existing 76-session historical Development only, 3800 frozen candidate events; Frozen v1 anchors are primary conditional diagnostic population

featurePanel.name: range6Pct
featurePanel.definition: 100*(max high - min low)/latest close of exactly six preceding completed scheduled 5m bars

featurePanel.name: lastCloseLocation
featurePanel.definition: (close-low)/(high-low) on immediately preceding completed 5m bar; zero range is NULL

featurePanel.name: lastUpperWickFraction
featurePanel.definition: (high-max(open,close))/(high-low) on immediately preceding completed 5m bar; zero range is NULL

featurePanel.name: turnover6Jpy
featurePanel.definition: Sum of source-observed turnover of the six preceding completed scheduled 5m bars; missing Va is NULL, never zero; partial minute observations disclosed

featurePanel.name: relativeVolume5
featurePanel.definition: Unmodified AVAILABLE value in canonical feasibility event; missing retained

featurePanel.name: directionalVwapDistancePct
featurePanel.definition: Unmodified AVAILABLE value in canonical feasibility event; HLC3-volume VWAP proxy, not transaction VWAP

featurePanel.name: priorSelectionCount
featurePanel.definition: Count strictly earlier same-symbol same-session frozen Top5 events

featurePanel.name: ridgeDeltaPreviousSelection
featurePanel.definition: Current frozen Ridge score minus most recent earlier same-symbol same-session score; no earlier event is NULL

outcomes.primary: Saved fixed-LONG-EXIT net reference return > 0; NULL outcome excluded from association denominator only

analysis.type: Descriptive no-fit feature ranking screen, NOT model OOF or new validation
statistics: Spearman versus fixed EXIT net and D30
analysis.chronological: Reuse existing four disjoint 15-session evaluation windows; no model training or direction fitting
analysis.symbol: Reuse existing SHA256 symbol grouping, report all76 and last15 separately; no unseen-symbol model-performance claim
analysis.primaryPopulation: Frozen v1 277 entry anchors; full 3800 candidate population is supporting
analysis.orientation: Raw feature AUC reported without choosing entry thresholds. At most descriptive direction concordance; all searches counted as outcome-exposed exploratory research
analysis.candidateAdvanceHeuristic: For a newly screened feature, v1-anchor primary-label univariate AUC >=0.60 or <=0.40, same direction in >=3/4 temporal windows and >=3/5 symbol groups, with two-class denominators reported; direction persists after removing largest positive and negative fixed-EXIT contributors. This nominates further research, NOT acceptance or statistically confirmed edge. Missing or sparse groups are UNKNOWN, not FAIL.
analysis.noIncrementalPredictionClaim: Marginal association alone is not incremental value beyond frozen score, time and symbol; future model comparison required
analysis.noKillingAllHistoricalResearch: Lack of univariate separation does not prove no nonlinear or joint signal; verdict applies only to this bounded screen

limitations: Frozen Selector and v1 exposed to all76 sessions
Candidate membership conditioned on historical label availability
Historical normalization barEnd is not measured realtime arrival time
OHLCV reference outcomes are not verified fills
8-feature multi-outcome exploratory screen is not confirmatory testing
